name: Chicken Fajita Pasta
method: Cook the pasta to the packet instructions, saving a mug of the cooking water, then drain.
Toss the sliced chicken in the fajita seasoning and fry in the oil for 6 to 8 minutes. Add the sliced onion and peppers and cook for 5 minutes more.
Stir in the tomato puree and passata and simmer for 5 minutes, loosening with a splash of the pasta water if needed.
Mix in the pasta and yoghurt, scatter over the grated cheese and serve. It is also good cold the next day.
